style.styleTitle: Personalised Royale Christmas Rose Wreath by Dibor
style.toneOfVoice: <p>This lovingly crafted door wreath is blooming with large, rich red roses for a luxurious Christmas decoration with a romantic twist that’s sure to make your home stand out. A real showstopper, the traditional wreath boasts a classic festive colour palette, with the ruby roses contrasting beautifully against the rich forest green leaves and metallic gold baubles.</p><p>Key Features:</p><p>• Snow dusted pinecones and plump berries are nestled among the evergreen foliage, elevating the classic Christmas wreath with fabulous quality and attention to detail.<br>• Complete with a jute hanging rope, so it can be hung in pride of place on your front door, or as an indoor wreath perhaps.<br>• Each wreath is complete with a wooden tag engraved with your chosen bespoke message.</p><p>Product Specifications:<br>• Diameter 58cm</p><p></p>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
This lovingly crafted door wreath is blooming with large, rich red roses for a luxurious Christmas decoration with a romantic twist that’s sure to make your home stand out. A real showstopper, the traditional wreath boasts a classic festive colour palette, with the ruby roses contrasting beautifully against the rich forest green leaves and metallic gold baubles.

Key Features:
• Snow dusted pinecones and plump berries are nestled among the evergreen foliage, elevating the classic Christmas wreath with fabulous quality and attention to detail.
• Complete with a jute hanging rope, so it can be hung in pride of place on your front door, or as an indoor wreath perhaps.
• Each wreath is complete with a wooden tag engraved with your chosen bespoke message.

Product Specifications:
• Diameter 58cm
